target: Total regulation-time corners: P(total >= 9), P(total >= 10), P(total >= 11)
sourcePolicy: Use validated Football-Data HC/AC counts and original fixture identities. Missing or invalid corners remain unknown; zero is a valid observed count. Keep original goal labels unchanged. Closed seasons must contain 380 results. Pin source bytes and report common corner coverage explicitly.
dataFence: All training corners and empirical reference probabilities use only fixtures strictly before target date minus one calendar day. Final weights use only records strictly before as-of date minus one calendar day. Target corners, target shots, actual lineup or live-match state never enter their own pre-match forecast.
meanModel: Weighted team attack/defence corner-count Poisson regression with pooled home advantage and ridge shrinkage. Rates and intercept bounds are corner-specific. Total mean is home plus away mean.
distribution: Poisson total or negative-binomial total; the latter fits one bounded past-only overdispersion parameter using the trained total means. No claim of independent negative-binomial side counts. Evaluate exact survival probabilities, not truncated renormalized score grids.
selectionRule: Select minimum mean binary log loss across the three thresholds on identical complete-corner validation fixtures. Persist selection before evaluating only that recipe on the audit. Threshold accuracy is secondary; do not mix corner and 1X2 accuracy denominators.
auditGate: Require lower mean binary log loss and Brier than the past-only empirical league reference. Report each threshold, current-season monitoring, paired day-clustered confidence intervals and predictive interval coverage. A historical pass does not establish prospective calibration.
caveat: These seasons were inspected previously for other outcomes. This is retrospective development of a new target, not an untouched external holdout. Future corner forecasts require their own frozen comparison and final-corner settlement.
